criteria_verification.notes: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements 3-member IdentityProvider port with sync currentPrincipal backed by _currentPrincipal field. Tests pass (3/3). Evidence: implementation exists, tests verify behavior.

Silent refresh before interactive flow verified. _performSignIn checks store, attempts _silentRefresh via FlutterAppAuth.token(), falls back to interactive only on failure. Test 'a valid stored session refreshes silently' passes with 0 interactive calls.
Interactive flow uses KeycloakConfig.redirectUrl (com.appmilla.studytutor:/oauth2redirect) and KeycloakConfig.scopes (includes offline_access). Tests verify configuration parameters.

Evidence bundle marks as rejected. Player reports implementation has distinct SignInCancelled and SignInFailed exceptions, but test verification fails due to Flutter test framework limitations with async exception testing. Implementation may be correct but verification is incomplete—cannot approve without demonstrated test evidence or alternative verification method.
Single-flight guard implemented via _signInInFlight Future tracking. Test 'second concurrent signIn shares one flow' passes: 3 concurrent calls result in only 1 interactive flow.
Proactive refresh implemented via _scheduleProactiveRefresh() scheduling Timer 5 minutes before accessTokenExpirationDateTime. Test 'refreshes before access token expiry' passes.

Sign-out wins refresh race via generation-based protection: signOut() increments _generation before clearing state; background refresh checks generation matches before updating principal. Test 'wins over in-flight refresh' passes.

Graceful degradation on unrecoverable refresh verified. _performBackgroundRefresh has try-catch that clears _currentPrincipal and store on failure without throwing. Test 'unrecoverable refresh clears principal without throwing' passes.
Absent/unreadable/expired session treated as signed out. Constructor initializes _currentPrincipal to null. Tests for absent and unreadable sessions both pass.
Hermetic tests verified. FakeAppAuth and FakeSecureSessionStore implemented. Constructor injection enables test isolation. No browser, network, or platform channel dependencies. 14/15 tests pass.
